criteria.requirement: Citizens of all non-EU countries, except listed categories (Romanian origin, protection in Romania, diplomatic or international-organisation staff in Romania, existing Romanian state scholars).
criteria.applicant: Nationality: DRC (not an EU country; none of the listed exceptions applies).
criteria.quote: Foreign citizens from all non-EU countries

criteria.requirement: Master's programmes are addressed to holders of a first (bachelor's) degree.
criteria.quote: master’s degree programmes are addressed to undergraduates

criteria.requirement: Average of at least 7 (Romanian scale) or 'Good' for the last school graduated.
criteria.missing: Final grade / average of the bachelor's degree
criteria.quote: have good results in education, respectively an average of the study years, for the last graduated school of at least 7 (seven)

criteria.requirement: Any field except medicine, dental medicine and pharmacy.
criteria.applicant: Interests: operations, business analysis, programme coordination, public policy (not medicine).
criteria.quote: scholarships are NOT awarded in the fields of MEDICINE, DENTAL MEDICINE and PHARMACY

funding.conditions: For no more than the duration of one university cycle.
funding.quote: financing the tuition expenses for the actual studies, but not more than the duration of a university cycle
financing the tuition expenses for the Romanian language preparatory year

funding.conditions: Monthly scholarship; amount not stated on the pages read.
funding.quote: granting a monthly scholarship, for students enrolled in bachelor's, master's or doctoral studies

funding.conditions: Student dormitories, within the ministry subsidy and subject to available places.
funding.quote: financing the accommodation expenses in the student dormitories, within the allocated subsidy

funding.conditions: Exemption from registration, application-processing and language-test fees.
funding.quote: exemption from the payment of registration fees or any other fees required by application processing

out_of_pocket: Unknown (airfare, visa, insurance and living costs above the unstated monthly scholarship are not addressed)
